title: Announcing the Winners of the 2024 Cannabis & Tech Today Innovation Awards: Stardust by Sorting Robotics
summary: The wait is over! After months of voting, we’re thrilled to announce the winners of the 2024 Cannabis & Tech Today Innovation Awards.
body_markdown:
The wait is over! After months of voting, we’re thrilled to announce the winners of the 2024 Cannabis & Tech Today Innovation Awards.


This year’s entries brought an impressive mix of game-changing technology, streamlined solutions, and eco-conscious advancements. Each product on this list tackles critical challenges in the cannabis industry, setting the stage for a brighter, more efficient future. Here are your 2024 winners, and the stories behind their groundbreaking work.
